title: Suggestions (proposed - awaiting owner; nothing implemented without a decision)
policy: Ranked by decision value per unit of work; every suggestion leaves the owner decision column blank.

rows.suggestion: Add a 'series' page to the root dashboard that renders the newest capture delta (a->b->c) instead of any single injury level
rows.why: REQ-21 says publish the delta, never the level; the root landing page currently links level-style pages

rows.suggestion: Pin the reg-week pages (reg1..reg18) in the snapshotter, not just /injuries/ (current week)
rows.why: REQ-48-style recounts need immutable week pages; today's recount shows the page mutates after the week
rows.effort: small (extend capture URL list + drift pins)

rows.suggestion: Join the reserve ledger to every capture automatically and publish the contradiction count per read
rows.why: F-WS-04 shows table/ledger divergence is per-club and time-varying
rows.effort: medium (join keyed on player URL slug)

rows.suggestion: Treat player URL slugs as identity keys in every parser (display names collide/mismatch)
rows.why: F-WS-08 (Dee Alford / deaundre-ford) and peer identity defects
